digest.component_or_area: bridge/reconcile CLI and engine command routing
propositions: Canonical CLI routes (preview/sync) and legacy routes (reconcile with mode/filter-local-ids) must coexist with distinct defaults and filtering semantics while normalizing to a shared core engine path
Legacy --filter-local-ids must retain post-differ write filtering while canonical --only/--except narrow differ inputs pre-execution
Selection tokens must resolve atomically to existing local IDs or Jira keys before lock acquisition, exiting 2 on unresolvable input without lock or mutation
Target IDs that disappear between preflight resolution and locked load must be detected, named, and rejected before differ/apply/persist seams
Explicit max-changes caps (10/100) apply deterministic partitions with retained applied/deferred manifests while uncapped live behavior and legacy bootstrap remain unchanged
Library rebar.reconcile() and MCP reconcile tool must remain callable with historical defaults and gating behavior including Mode/MODE_CAPS and reconcile-check diagnostic path
